title: Sustainable oleogel encapsulation of tilapia fish oil using protein-based cryogels: fabrication, characterization, and digestion behavior
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1480-1491
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00322A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Daniel Tua Purba, Jaydeep Dave, Pichayada Somboon
This study demonstrates how protein-based cryogels encapsulate sustainable tilapia fish oil into oleogels, enhancing oxidative stability and enabling controlled FFA release during digestion.
